name: 51725-longprefill-qwen3-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (target) + deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7 (DSpark drafter, block_size 7). Both bf16, 21.1 GB of weights on one card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, bounded at 100 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -> 80 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 8000 prompt and 1000 output tokens with min = max on both. Prompts are drawn independently, so prefix caching (on) has nothing to reuse. The chat template puts the engine's own prompt-token count a handful above 8000, and the backend sets ignore_eos when max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 1000. Seed static 42.
purpose: An 8B document summarizer condensing 8,000-token filings into 1,000-token digests one at a time, with a drafter, on a single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE: this file is read line by line and indented lines are skipped, so
# re-flowing the value into a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts without the
# drafter at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"model": "deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7", "method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "attention_backend": "FLASH_ATTN"}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: true
trust-remote-code: true
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-chunked-prefill: true

# HAZARD: the FlashInfer autotune pass runs during kernel warmup on every Hopper card and aborts
# bring-up here on an ImportError; nothing in this deployment goes through FlashInfer. See
# configs/note.md.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
